name: before_long_trip
description: Use when the owner plans a long trip and wants a quick check that nothing is wrong or due: cooling, maintenance due and the DPF.
instructions: Call run_skill {"name":"before_long_trip"}: it runs each check offered for this car among cooling, maintenance and dpf and merges their results.
When the triage shows codes, call read_dtcs or open check_engine_light; when the triage battery voltage is low, add battery_charging.
End with a short list: fine to go, or what to check first, each point citing its step.
interpret: Any overheating or critical finding: the trip should wait until it is checked.
Overdue maintenance (oil, timing belt, brake fluid) matters more before a long drive: name the items due.
A DPF that is filling or due for a regeneration is usually helped by the motorway drive itself, as long as no warning light is on.
Pending codes deserve a mention: they may turn into a warning light on the way.
